GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked to lead. led turn. weakened in Straight # Ordinary Effort
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths rail turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the finish had to be steadied away from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd & worked to race 3rd Two Wide No Cover (2L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground until improving slowly from 650m. Pushed to quicken Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 300m & weakened in straight. # Worked & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (3L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along on rail (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & gave ground in last 200m. # didn't finish off
Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 2 lengths. under pressure turn 3 lengths. dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider advised that her mount did not travel during the event, failed to respond to her riding in the straight and may have come to the end of its preparation. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Over-raced Four Wide before pushed fwd to lead on rail by 1/2L @ 800m. Held lead on inside midrace & held together =lead Two Wide on home turn. Pushed along & laid out Five Wide @ 300m. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & boxed on until faded in last 100m. Vetted clear. # On-pace/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr stated that his mount raced greenly throughout the event and proved very difficult to settle. He added that, near the 1000m, when racing greenly, his mount got its head up and had to be shifted out to avoid heels.  A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.  Trainer was advised that a warning would be placed on the gelding’s record for its racing manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out eased to last 11l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong making good ground late # best work late
slow out x 2 Lengths . Settled Down Inside 8th, all of 5 Lengths @ 800m. 4 Lengths Ridden Along Inside Straightening Up . Just Held Ground . 1st 2 out 1st 2 home # slow start no help
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bounded on jumping and lost ground. Over-raced through the early and middle stages. Laid out rounding the home turn and proved difficult to obtain completely clear running in the early part of the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Six Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & tried to sprint with winner @ 250m. Tried hard but no match in last 200m. Pacifiers 1st time. # Tried hard/no match
(ear muffs first time) Jumped Well , Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd within 1 length @ 800m. same to turn No Cover . hung out entering Straight , Gradually Gave Ground from there # wide/faded/learning
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages before laying out and making the home turn very awkwardly.
